scene: You peer inside the hollow acorn postbox, discovering several peculiar objects.
picture: Close-up first-person view inside the hollow acorn postbox. On the left lies a folded paper envelope sealed with red wax. In the center sits an ornate brass key with clockwork notches. On the right, a glowing cyan crystal knob is set into the carved wooden interior wall.
shown: A wax-sealed envelope with a stamp, lying flat on the left.
An ornate brass key resting quietly in the center.
A glowing cyan crystal knob mounted to the wooden panel on the right.

variants.scene: A warm glow spills from the hollow nook, revealing three hidden treasures.
You lean into the round wooden hollow, breathing in the scent of cedar.
Tucked inside the dark hollow, a cyan crystal sparkles beside an old letter.
